text: OCR processor extracts text and structured content from PDF documents and images
quote: Use the Document AI OCR processor to extract text and structured content from PDF documents and images.

text: Tables can be output as markdown or HTML via a table_format parameter
quote: Table formatting supports `null`, `markdown`, and `html` values through the `table_format` parameter.

text: Headers and footers can be extracted into separate header and footer response fields
quote: Header and footer extraction uses the `extract_header` and `extract_footer` parameters. When you use them, the response includes header and footer content in the `header` and `footer` fields.

text: Block extraction returns paragraph-level bounding boxes, structural block labels, and content in reading order per page
quote: Block extraction uses the `include_blocks` parameter. When enabled, each page contains a `blocks` array with paragraph-level bounding boxes, structural block labels, and extracted content in reading order.

text: Confidence scores for extracted content at page, block, or word granularity
quote: Confidence scores are available for extracted content at page, block, or word granularity through the `confidence_scores_granularity` parameter.

text: Bounding-box annotation of figures and charts extracted by OCR, e.g. describing or captioning a figure in a user-defined format
